title: DOW-UAP-PR058, "[CALLSIGN] (Mission) UAP"
what_is_it: A infrared video recording from a U.S. military platform operating in the Indo-Pacific region, uploaded to a classified network and later released as part of the PURSUE collection.
interpretation_warnings: The video was digitally altered prior to upload — the nature and extent of alteration is not specified.
The callsign identifying the military platform has been redacted throughout.
The materials lack a substantiated chain-of-custody, meaning provenance cannot be independently verified.
The auto-transcribed audio contains only repeated instances of the word 'You' — no substantive dialogue or narration is recoverable.
AARO uses the qualifier 'likely' when attributing the video to a U.S. military infrared sensor, indicating this is an assessment rather than a confirmed fact.
The video text references 'possible changes of shape' — this is the uploader's characterisation, not an official AARO assessment.
The video content visible is limited to a black screen with overlaid text for the first 4 seconds; the remainder is not described in the available source text.

verifiable_claims.claim: The video likely comes from an infrared sensor on a U.S. military platform in the INDOPACOM area
verifiable_claims.source_quote: is likely derived from an infrared sensor aboard a U.S. military platform operating within the United States Indo-Pacific Command area of responsibility
